quote: Strena seu de Nive Sexangula (On the Six-Cornered Snowflake), published in 1611
note: Kepler formulated his famous conjecture about the densest packing of equal-sized spheres in 3D space. The problem originated from a practical inquiry by Sir Walter Raleigh to his adviser Thomas Harriot about efficiently stacking cannonballs, which led to Kepler's formulation. Modern extensions to higher dimensions remain largely unsolved.
